Small n8n change, big deal if you run AI on a client's account.

n8n 2.43.0 (released 6 Oct 2026) added an opt-in budget guardrail for agent runs. The same release added resumable executions at node boundaries.

Why I care: whether it's a clinic, a restaurant or an online shop, owners fear one thing about AI more than bad answers. A bill they didn't expect. A spend cap on agent runs is an easy promise to make on a sales call, as long as you actually switch it on.

It's opt-in, so check your instance version and settings before you promise it.

Source: n8n release notes, v2.43.0.
